themes.label: Managed on their own
themes.definition: The household coped by itself, through its own work or by finding its own way through, without outside help.

themes.label: Savings or credit
themes.definition: Used savings or an emergency fund, or took or renewed a loan, or asked to change repayments, from VisionFund or another lender.

themes.label: Changed farming practices
themes.definition: Irrigation, buying water, drought-resistant or different seeds, replanting, or dams to protect crops.

themes.label: New income source
themes.definition: Started a new business, side job or trade to replace lost income.

themes.label: Worked harder
themes.definition: Worked more hours or harder, or pushed an existing business further.

themes.label: Sold assets
themes.definition: Sold land, livestock, crops or other possessions to get money or keep up repayments.

themes.label: Cut spending
themes.definition: Reduced household spending, meals or other expenses.

themes.label: Repairs, relocation or equipment
themes.definition: Repaired the home, moved because of flooding or damage, or bought equipment such as a generator.

themes.label: Acceptance or faith
themes.definition: Accepted the situation, was patient, or left it to God, without a practical step.

themes.label: Could not cope
themes.definition: Could not deal with the shock at all, or suffered loss without any way through.

themes.label: Shock had no real effect
themes.definition: Says the shock caused no problem or nothing needed doing.
